preconditions.description: The number of cards n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The required total power k is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= 1000 for pi, ci, li in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card's power pi is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= 100000 for pi, ci, li in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card's magic number ci is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= n for pi, ci, li in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card's level li is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (1 <= return_value <= n and any(sum(pi for pi, ci, li in deck) >= k for deck in valid_decks))
postconditions.description: The return value is -1 if no valid deck can be built, otherwise it is the minimum level Vova needs to reach to build a deck with total power at least k.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(ci for pi, ci, li in deck) != p for deck in valid_decks for p in primes if p <= 2 * max(ci for pi, ci, li in cards))
postconditions.description: For any valid deck, the sum of the magic numbers of the cards in the deck is not a prime number.

postconditions.expression: all(li <= return_value for pi, ci, li in deck for deck in valid_decks)
postconditions.description: For any valid deck, the level of each card in the deck is less than or equal to the return value.
